newsitem.title: THAILAND: Land and Houses clarifies big Q2 loss.
newsitem.headline: Land and Houses clarifies big Q2 loss.

text.p: Major Thai property developer Land and Houses Plc said on Friday its heavy loss in the second quarter was due to losses in their portfolio investment and foreign exchange losses as a result of the baht flotation.
Land and Houses on Friday announced a net loss of 1.81 billion baht ($58 million) in the second quarter compared with the profit of 608 million in the same period last year.
Land and Houses said in a statement the company had realized accounting losses of 1.13 billion baht from its portfolio investment in the quarter and foreign exchange loss of 800 million baht.
The Thai baht has tumbled by more than 20 percent after the Bank of Thailand floated it on July 2.
"The realisation of the net loss will have a positive impact on the company's cash flow as it would exempt the company from mid-year and year-end income tax payments," the company said.
Land and Houses paid more than 700 million baht in taxes last year, the company said.
